English Helper ("the Service") shows English subtitles alongside a translation on YouTube, Netflix, Disney+, and Coupang Play, and lets you save selected sentences and words to review later. This policy explains what the Service does — and does not — do with your information.

Core principle — only what you explicitly save is sent to a server.
Subtitles shown during playback are never transmitted, words you look up in the dictionary are not transmitted, and the Service does not automatically record what you watch.

1. Information we collect

a. Account information (only if you sign in)

To sync across devices, signing in processes your email address and an account identifier (UID). Authentication is handled by Google Firebase Authentication; the Service never stores or sees your password. All subtitle features work without signing in.

b. Learning data you save

The following is stored and synced only when you press the save button on a sentence or word.

CategoryFields
Saved contentThe sentence or word you saved, its dictionary definition, the translation of the sentence
Source contextPlatform name, content title, content identifier, playback position within the video
Review historyTime saved, review count and level, next and last review times

Source context exists so that a saved expression can later be reviewed together with the scene it came from. As a result, the title of the content you were watching is retained for the items you save. Viewing of content you did not save from is not recorded.

c. What we do not collect

  • The full text of subtitles shown during playback — processed on your device only, never transmitted or retained
  • Words you look up in the dictionary — see section 5 for why these never reach a server
  • Viewing history for content you did not save from, lists of websites visited, or search history
  • Location, contacts, payment information, or health information
  • Advertising identifiers or other tracking identifiers — the Service shows no ads and does not track users

2. Information stored only on your device

The following stays in your browser or device and is never transmitted. Removing the extension or clearing browser storage deletes it.

  • Subtitle preferences (native language, display mode, font sizes, amount shown per line)
  • Feature on/off and panel visibility state, panel width, and subtitle overlay position
  • A local copy of saved items and the sync queue — these stay on the device if you do not sign in
  • Your sign-in token
  • Cached dictionary data

3. How we use information

  • To display dual subtitles over video and provide the transcript panel
  • To store the expressions you save and sync them across your devices
  • To schedule reviews

We do not use this information for advertising, sell it, or provide it for creditworthiness purposes.

4. Third parties and processors

We do not sell or share personal information with third parties. We do rely on the following provider's infrastructure to operate the Service, which means data is stored on their servers.

ProcessorPurposeData processed
Google LLC
(Firebase Authentication,
Cloud Firestore)		 Account authentication; storage and sync of learning data Email, UID, and the learning data described in 1(b)

This data is stored in Google's data centers and may be held outside your country of residence. See Firebase's privacy information for details on Google's processing.

5. How dictionary lookups work

When you look up a word, the Service does not send that word to a server. Instead it downloads dictionary files grouped by the opening letters of words, stores them on your device, and performs the lookup locally.

As a consequence, the Service's dictionary host may retain ordinary web server access logs recording which group file was requested, when, and from which IP address. Group file names are the first two or three letters of a word, so these logs indicate only which range of starting letters was consulted, not which word. Once a group has been downloaded it is kept on the device, so repeated lookups in the same range generate no request at all. These logs are used solely to operate and troubleshoot the Service.

6. Retention and deletion

  • Learning data is retained until you delete it or delete your account.
  • Individual items can be deleted at any time from the saved list; deleting an item also deletes its synced copy.
  • Deleting your account deletes that account's learning data and account information without undue delay.

7. Your rights and how to exercise them

  • Access — every saved item is visible in the saved list.
  • Deletion — delete individual items from the saved list.
  • Account and full data deletion — request account deletion from the app's settings, or contact us using the details below.
  • Stop syncing — sign out, and subsequent data stays on your device only.

8. Security

  • All communication is encrypted with HTTPS.
  • Firestore security rules restrict each user to their own data.
  • Passwords are managed by Firebase Authentication and are not retained by the Service.

9. Children's privacy

The Service is not directed to children under 14, or under the minimum age of digital consent in the user's jurisdiction, whichever is higher, and we do not knowingly collect their personal information. If we become aware of such data, we delete it without undue delay.

10. Changes to this policy

If this policy changes, we will post the change and its effective date on this page. Significant changes will also be announced within the Service.
